news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI system, installing it in operating rooms at LDS Hospital in Salt Lake City and American Fork Hospital, Utah, for real-time intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment. CEO Adrian Mendes called it 'a defining moment for Perimeter and for the use of AI in cancer surgery as a whole.'

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI to Participate in the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a corporate update at the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas, laying out Perimeter's commercial strategy for Claire following its FDA approval and outlining near-term catalysts for the OCT+AI rollout.

news.headline: Perimeter Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Perimeter reported Q1 2026 revenue of approximately $385,000, with 14% year-over-year growth in recurring revenue from its legacy S-Series OCT base, and a net loss that improved about 31% versus Q1 2025 as the company prepared for Claire's U.S. commercial launch.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: As of August 15, 2026, Perimeter had not yet released results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026; based on the Q1 cadence (results and call on May 28), a release is expected in the coming weeks and should show initial Claire commercial revenue.

catalysts.label: Expansion of Claire OCT+AI hospital placements
catalysts.detail: Following the first live deployment at Intermountain Health's LDS and American Fork hospitals under the systemwide agreement, additional Intermountain sites and new health-system customers are the next expected commercial milestones.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. redomiciling / Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has an embedded option to redomicile from British Columbia to a U.S. jurisdiction, subject to shareholder and board approval; completing this would remove a key barrier to a future Nasdaq uplisting, seen as a potential re-rating catalyst.

catalysts.label: Recurring-revenue ramp from S-Series OCT installed base
catalysts.detail: Continued growth in consumable/recurring revenue from the existing ~21+ installed S-Series OCT systems, alongside new Claire placements, is the company's stated near-term commercial focus.

pulse: Perimeter has moved from regulatory approval into first commercial execution: after Claire (its AI-enabled wide-field OCT system) received FDA premarket approval in March 2026 as the first AI-enabled device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to put Claire into live surgical use on August 13, 2026, across its LDS and American Fork hospitals. The build-out was funded through a string of 2026 capital raises (LIFE offering, private placements, convertible debentures), and the company is now focused on expanding hospital placements and recurring OCT revenue, with Q2 2026 results still pending as of mid-August. Shares trade thinly on the TSXV (PINK) and OTCQX (PYNKF), with a market cap around the low-$30M range in early August 2026, making the stock highly sensitive to hospital-adoption and financing news.
